label: pH minimum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the minimum pH value supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000705.

label: pH maximum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the maximum pH value supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000706.

label: temperature minimum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the minimum temperature supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000702.

label: temperature maximum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the maximum temperature supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000703.

label: salinity minimum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the minimum salinity/NaCl concentration supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000708.

label: salinity maximum tolerance
definition: An environmental quality (class form) that describes the maximum salinity/NaCl concentration supporting growth. Companion to datatype property METPO:2000709.

label: flagellar arrangement
definition: A phenotype characterized by the arrangement pattern of flagella on a bacterial or archaeal cell (e.g. peritrichous, polar, amphitrichous, lophotrichous, monotrichous, lateral, subpolar).

label: polytrichous flagellation
definition: A flagellar arrangement in which multiple flagella (typically a tuft) are present per cell, often combined with polar attachment.

label: colony morphology
definition: A phenotype characterized by macroscopic colony characteristics such as shape, margin, elevation, surface, colour, and size.

label: colony shape
definition: A colony morphology characterized by the overall macroscopic colony outline as observed on solid medium.

label: circular colony
definition: A colony shape that has a regular round outline.

label: irregular colony
definition: A colony shape that has an irregular (non-round, non-rhizoid) outline.

label: filamentous colony
definition: A colony shape that has a thread-like or filamentous outline.

label: punctiform colony
definition: A colony shape that is very small (pinpoint), typically <1 mm in diameter.

label: rhizoid colony
definition: A colony shape that has a branching, root-like outline.

label: fried-egg-shaped colony
definition: A colony shape that has a raised opaque centre and a translucent peripheral zone, resembling a fried egg.

label: pressure tolerance
definition: A phenotype characterized by the ability to grow under elevated hydrostatic pressure.

label: barophile phenotype
definition: A pressure tolerance in which an organism requires or tolerates elevated hydrostatic pressure for growth.

label: radiation tolerance
definition: A phenotype characterized by the ability to withstand ionizing or UV radiation.

label: osmotic tolerance
definition: A phenotype characterized by the ability to grow under high osmotic pressure (non-NaCl).

label: metal tolerance
definition: A phenotype characterized by the ability to grow in the presence of elevated metal concentrations.

label: capsule presence
definition: A phenotype characterized by the presence of an extracellular polysaccharide capsule.

label: biofilm formation capability
definition: A phenotype characterized by the ability to form surface-attached biofilms.

label: catalase test
definition: A biochemical test that detects catalase enzyme activity by exposing cells to hydrogen peroxide and observing for visible bubbling. The test outcome (positive or negative) is captured by its child classes; this class itself does not assert that the organism has catalase activity.

label: catalase positive
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the catalase test yields a positive result (visible bubbling on H2O2). The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000302 'shows activity of' GO:0004096 'catalase activity'.

label: catalase negative
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the catalase test yields a negative result (no bubbling on H2O2). The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000303 'does not show activity of' GO:0004096 'catalase activity'.

label: oxidase test
definition: A biochemical test that detects cytochrome c oxidase activity using a redox indicator. The test outcome (positive or negative) is captured by its child classes; this class itself does not assert oxidase activity.

label: oxidase positive
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the oxidase test yields a positive result. The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000302 'shows activity of' GO:0004129 'cytochrome-c oxidase activity'.

label: oxidase negative
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the oxidase test yields a negative result. The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000303 'does not show activity of' GO:0004129 'cytochrome-c oxidase activity'.

label: urease test
definition: A biochemical test that detects urease enzyme activity by observing urea hydrolysis (typically via a pH-indicator color change). The test outcome (positive or negative) is captured by its child classes; this class itself does not assert urease activity.

label: urease positive
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the urease test yields a positive result. The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000302 'shows activity of' GO:0009039 'urease activity'.

label: urease negative
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the urease test yields a negative result. The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000303 'does not show activity of' GO:0009039 'urease activity'.

label: coagulase activity
definition: A phenotype characterized by coagulase enzyme activity (clotting of blood plasma); a diagnostic marker, e.g. for Staphylococcus aureus.

label: coagulase positive
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the coagulase test yields a positive result (plasma clotting). The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000302 'shows activity of' <coagulase enzyme term> once a sufficiently specific enzyme term is selected (no GO/EC term currently exists at the bacteriological coagulase test granularity).

label: coagulase negative
definition: Test-outcome phenotype where the coagulase test yields a negative result. The underlying enzyme-organism relation should additionally be asserted via <organism> METPO:2000303 'does not show activity of' <coagulase enzyme term> once a sufficiently specific enzyme term is selected.

label: xerophilic phenotype
definition: A phenotype characterized by a microbe that thrives in low water-activity environments (typically aw < 0.85), where the limiting factor is water activity (aw) rather than solute concentration; distinct from halophily and osmotic tolerance.

label: epibiont phenotype
definition: A phenotype characterized by a microbe that lives on the external surface of a host organism or substrate, as distinct from endosymbionts (which live inside the host); captures host-association mode, not specific host taxonomy.

label: aquatic microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in aquatic environments (fresh water, marine, brackish).
observations: PREGO edges: 25,429 (aquatic biome 12,442 + freshwater biome 7,873 + marine biome 5,114).

label: terrestrial microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in terrestrial environments including soil and land biomes.

label: marine microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in marine (saltwater) environments.
observations: PREGO edges: 16,702 (aggregated marine biome + ocean + marine environment + deep marine sediment).

label: freshwater microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in freshwater environments (lakes, rivers, ponds).
observations: PREGO edges: 20,765 (freshwater biome 7,873 + fresh water 6,035 + river 3,936 + lake 2,921).

label: soil microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in soil environments.

label: gut-associated microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in animal intestinal (gut) environments.

label: biofilm-associated microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in biofilm structures.

label: anthropogenic-environment microorganism
definition: Microbe with literature-attested occurrence in built or human-modified environments (farms, urban infrastructure, agricultural land).
observations: PREGO edges: 16,884 (aggregated anthropogenic environment + agricultural land).

label: biofilm-forming
definition: Organism capable of forming a biofilm — a structured community of microorganisms attached to a surface within a self-produced extracellular matrix.

label: quorum-sensing capable
definition: Organism capable of quorum sensing — cell-to-cell communication via secreted signaling molecules whose concentration reports on population density.

label: flocculating
definition: Organism capable of flocculation — forming aggregated cell masses that settle out of suspension.

label: anaerobic ammonium oxidizing
definition: Organism capable of anaerobic respiration using ammonium as the electron donor (anammox).
observations: PREGO edges: 88 (GO:0019331 anaerobic respiration using ammonium as electron donor).
